children: XYO Network and Gate AI have launched Crypto Cards, a daily onchain game in which users predict crypto price moves against an AI model and other players. Every selection is recorded on XYO Layer One, while Gate market data determines the results of each round.

The game gives XYO Layer One a recurring transaction source, since each daily round requires players to record selections onchain. Association with Gate also brings exchange-brand visibility to the network.

Adoption depends on sustained player interest, and the announcement describes no direct token value-accrual mechanism, so chain activity is the observable effect rather than a stated link to token demand.
